headline: Lənkəran: mountainous region with high infrastructure coverage and low density

tags.reason: Forest cover is 27.9% and coastal territory features a mean elevation of 161 meters.
Affordability index is 75 and new apartment demo price is 850 AZN per square meter.

summary: Lənkəran is a regional administrative unit with a population of 228,600 and a density of 148 residents per square kilometre. The area features a mountainous terrain with coastal access, alongside a PM2.5 model value of 14.5. Road infrastructure shows a known paved share of 38.7% and an infrastructure index score of 93. Real estate price data rely entirely on mock confidence values, including 600 AZN per square meter for old apartments.
strengths: Known road network has a paved share of 38.7% against a national median of 4.35% (infrastruktur index 93, national median 45).
Forest landcover reaches 27.9% within the administrative boundaries (tebiet index 54, national median 51).
Affordability index stands at 75 compared to the national median of 50.
weaknesses: Grocery density is 1.09 per 10,000 residents against the national median of 2.29 (rahatliq index 44, national median 49.5).
Kindergarten density is 0.09 per 10,000 residents compared to the national median of 0.47.
Park density is 1.4 per 10,000 residents against the national median of 3.89.
best_for: Buyers seeking lower density and coastal mountainous geography.
Those targeting properties with mock new apartment values of 850 AZN per square meter.
watch_out: All real estate prices use mock confidence values and act only as demo figures.
Surface unknown percentage for roads reaches 88.8%.
confidence_note: OSM coverage is high and per capita metrics are reliable, but all listed real estate prices are mock demo values and must not be used for financial conclusions.
